plainText:
Iemasa Kayumi (Japanese: 家弓家正 Kayumi Iemasa) was a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Kayumi was born on October 31, 1933, in , , and became an actor as an adult. He joined the during , voicing Professor Rowan. Kayumi passed away on September 30, 2014, at the age of 80.
